verdicts.reason: A: the badge is shrunk and wedged between the subhead and the legal text with no relation to either. The legal copy is a cramped 3-line block in the corner, and the CTA floats on its own at the far right, off the text axis. The bottle is tiny and has lost its sun. B: the headline, subhead and legal text form one clear centred column with good size steps, and the bottle stays intact. However, the CTA butts right up against 'last', almost colliding with it, the badge is dumped in the bottom-left corner, and the logo is too small to read as the brand mark.
